scale_policy.rule: accept only DTM scenes whose native post spacing is <= 3.0 m; keep the g10/g15 area-fraction targets and the 1[g10>0.05] proxy rule at the same scale
scale_policy.rationale: native 2-7 m products are not automatically equivalent to the 3 m label definition; option A avoids relabelling the development set and keeps the external task comparable to the existing definition

optical_route.rule: fetch the raw LROC NAC EDR volumes through the institution network and orthorectify them with ISIS/SPICE onto each DTM grid; DTM-derived shade/slope/browse products must never be used as optical input
optical_route.rationale: the reachable public mirrors publish optical imagery for 8 of 181 candidates and 0 of the 128 passing scenes, so strict source verifiability cannot be preserved from those mirrors

candidate_pool.filter: source_disjoint AND footprint_disjoint AND resolution_m <= 3.0 (Gate 1 audit)
